spans.s: śodhaka, adj. or n. ag. (in Skt., rare, cleaning, purifying; Pali so˚), purifying (religiously), correcting (creatures); only in vss for viśodhaka, q.v.: sattvāḥ su-vineyāḥ su-˚kāḥ SP 〔301.6〕; 〔302.5〕 (vss).

śodhayati (in Skt., and Pali sodheti, in the sense of pays a debt or tax), clears up or away, attends to, accomplishes, specifically carries out a sentence upon a criminal: (devasya badhyaghātakāḥ puruṣāḥ) sthāpayitavyā ye devasya badhyakaraṇīyaṃ ˚yiṣyanti Divy 〔374.11〕.
